docs.title: 🧪 UiPath Labs Setup
docs.text:
Get your UiPath Labs environment ready for a workshop: your VM, your workshop account, and your tenant. Work through the tabs from left to right — each one ends with a check.

Training Environment

Log in at https://cloud.uipath.com/tpenlabs with your workshop account. You work in the tenants AgenticWorkshop and AgenticTestingWorkshop.

docs.title: 🎁 What UiPath Labs gives you
docs.text:
Everyone in the workshop gets the same ready-made environment, so nobody spends the session installing tools.

🖥️ A Windows VM

A virtual machine (VM) you open in your browser. Chrome, UiPath Studio, and the tools the workshop uses are already installed.

👤 A workshop account

A UiPath account made for the workshop. You sign in with it instead of your own account.

🏢 Two workshop tenants

The tenants AgenticWorkshop and AgenticTestingWorkshop, where Test Manager, Studio Web, and Orchestrator are ready for the exercises.

docs.title: 🗺️ The setup, step by step
docs.text:
1

Before you start

The two sets of details you receive, and what you need on your own machine

2

Connect to your VM

Open the VM with Remote Desktop, or in your browser through Azure Bastion

3

Sign in

Sign in to UiPath with your workshop account and confirm the tenant

4

Troubleshooting

What to do when a step doesn't work

Raise your hand early

If a step fails, stop and ask the trainer before you move on. A setup problem is much quicker to fix at the start than in the middle of an exercise.

docs.title: Before You Start
docs.text: Step 1 of 3

docs.title: 📋 Before You Start
docs.text: What you receive from UiPath Labs, and what you need on your own machine.

docs.title: 📨 The details you receive
docs.text: Before the workshop, you receive two emails from UiPath Labs (UiPathlabs@uipath.com). You may already have them in your inbox. Can't find them? Check your spam folder. You might also get a third email, which you ignore.

docs.title: ✉️ Email 1: Workshop Invitation
docs.text:
The subject is Workshop Invitation: and the workshop's name. It gives the date and the trainer of your workshop.

  1. Select Access Workshop, or copy the link from the email into Chrome. Don't forward the email: the link is yours.
  2. The workshop page opens. It shows the workshop's name, date, length, and trainer, and welcomes you by your email address.

  3. Select Confirm Attendance. Don't select Decline.

  4. After you confirm, the page shows the workshop content and your UiPath Labs details.

docs.title: 🖥️ Email 2: Sandbox created
docs.text:
The subject is Sandbox created. It tells you that your VM is ready, and when it's deleted. It also has a Click here to connect link for Azure Bastion, and an RDP file attached.

Keep this email, but you don't need its link: you connect from the workshop page in the next step.

Your VM has an end date

The VM is deleted at the date and time in this email, with everything on it. Finish the workshop before then.

docs.title: 🚫 Ignore: You are invited to join uipathlabsworkshop
docs.text:
You might also get an email from UiPath Platform (no-reply@uipath.com) with the subject You are invited to join uipathlabsworkshop. You don't need it.

Don't select Accept Invite

Ignore this email. You sign in with the workshop account from your UiPath Labs details, not through this invite.

docs.title: 🗂️ Your UiPath Labs details
docs.text:
After you confirm, the workshop page shows your sign-in details. If they're hidden, select Sign-in details. Keep this page open in a browser tab: you'll copy from it in the next steps.

🖥️ Sandbox sign-in (left)

Your VM. Its Username and Password, with copy buttons, and two ways to connect: Connect in browser and Remote Desktop file.

➡️ Used in Connect to your VM

👤 UiPath sign-in (right)

Your workshop account. The Username and Password you use with Continue with Microsoft.

➡️ Used in Sign in

Ignore the UiPath address

Don't use the Address under UiPath sign-in, or the Open UiPath button. The workshop uses https://cloud.uipath.com/tpenlabs. From UiPath sign-in, you only need the Username and Password.

Two different accounts

The Sandbox username signs you in to Windows on the VM. The UiPath username signs you in to UiPath. Don't mix them up, and don't use your own UiPath account during the workshop.

docs.title: 💻 What you need on your own machine
docs.text:
• A Remote Desktop client. On Windows, Remote Desktop Connection is built in. On a Mac, install Windows App from the App Store.
  • Google Chrome, up to date, for the workshop page. It also opens the VM if you use Azure Bastion.
  • Clipboard access to the VM. You'll paste usernames, passwords, and commands into it.
  • A stable internet connection. Close video calls you don't need.

You don't need to install anything else: every workshop tool runs inside the VM.

Keep your details private

Your VM and workshop account are yours for the session. Don't share the passwords, or paste them into a chat or a coding agent.

Ready for the next step

You have the workshop page open with your sign-in details, and a Remote Desktop client and Chrome on your machine. Next: connect to your VM.

docs.title: Connect to Your VM
docs.text: Step 2 of 3

docs.title: 🖥️ Connect to Your VM
docs.text: Open your VM with Remote Desktop, or in a browser tab with Azure Bastion. From here on, you work inside the VM.

docs.title: 🔌 Choose how to connect
docs.text:
Open your workshop page. Sandbox sign-in shows the VM's Username and Password, with copy buttons.

Remote Desktop is the recommended way. Use Azure Bastion if you can't use a Remote Desktop client.

🖥️ Remote Desktop (recommended)🌐 Azure Bastion
  1. Next to Sandbox, select Remote Desktop file.
  2. Open the downloaded .rdp file. It opens in Remote Desktop Connection on Windows, or in Windows App on a Mac.
  3. When you're asked for credentials, enter the Username from Sandbox sign-in: admin_1.

  4. Select the copy button next to Password in Sandbox sign-in, paste the password, and select Continue.

  5. If you're warned that the VM's certificate can't be verified, select Continue.

  6. Wait for the VM's Windows desktop to load.

Azure Bastion opens the VM in a Chrome tab, so you don't need a Remote Desktop client.

  1. Next to Sandbox, select Connect in browser.

  2. In the Azure Bastion form, keep Protocol on RDP and Port on 3389. Enter the Username and Password from Sandbox sign-in, pick your Keyboard Language, and select Login.

  3. When your browser asks whether to allow clipboard access, accept it.

  4. Wait for the VM's Windows desktop to load in the browser tab.

Can't paste into the VM with Ctrl+V?

In Chrome on your own machine, open chrome://settings/content/clipboard and make sure the Bastion site isn't under Not allowed to see your clipboard. Then reload the Bastion tab.

docs.title: 🧰 Your VM desktop
docs.text:
When the VM opens, you see its Windows desktop. This is where you work in the hands-on workshops. Your work stays on the VM until the date in the Sandbox created email.

The tools you need are already installed, with shortcuts on the desktop: Google Chrome, UiPath Studio, UiPath Assistant, Visual Studio Code, Git Bash, and Excel. You don't need to install anything.

docs.title: 📋 Check copy and paste
docs.text:
Copy something on your own machine, then paste it into the VM, for example into the Windows search box. If it pastes, you're done.

Ready for the next step

The VM's desktop is open, and pasting into it works. From now on, do every step inside the VM. Next: sign in.

docs.title: Sign In
docs.text: Step 3 of 3

docs.title: 🔑 Sign In
docs.text: Sign in to UiPath inside the VM with your workshop account, and check you can see both workshop tenants.

docs.title: 🌐 Sign in with your workshop account
docs.text:
1. Open Google Chrome in the VM and go to https://cloud.uipath.com/tpenlabs. Don't use Open UiPath on the workshop page: it opens another address.

  2. Select Continue with Microsoft.

  3. Enter the Username from UiPath sign-in and select Next.

  4. Enter the Password from UiPath sign-in and select Sign in.

  5. The home page of https://cloud.uipath.com/tpenlabs opens. Check that the address bar shows cloud.uipath.com/tpenlabs.

Use the workshop account, not your own

If Chrome signs you in with another account, sign out, then sign in again with Continue with Microsoft and your workshop account.

docs.title: ✅ Check your tenants
docs.text:
Your workshop account has access to two tenants: AgenticWorkshop and AgenticTestingWorkshop. Check that you can see both.

  1. In the upper-right corner, open the Tenant picker.

  2. Check that the list has AgenticWorkshop and AgenticTestingWorkshop. To find them faster, type a name in Search.

  3. If one of them is missing, tell the trainer.

Switch tenants with the Tenant picker

The trainer tells you which tenant each workshop uses. Select it in the Tenant picker before you start. Orchestrator services, on the home page, lists the same tenants.

Keep this tab open

You'll come back to this Chrome tab during the workshop. If a page ever goes blank or shows an old screen, open it in a fresh tab and check the tenant again.

Ready for the workshop

You're signed in at https://cloud.uipath.com/tpenlabs with your workshop account, and the Tenant picker shows AgenticWorkshop and AgenticTestingWorkshop. Your environment is ready for the workshop.

docs.title: Troubleshooting
docs.text: Help

docs.title: 🛠️ Troubleshooting
docs.text: Look up your symptom here before you raise your hand. If it isn't listed, or the fix doesn't work, ask the trainer.

docs.title: 🖥️ The VM
docs.text:
🚨 Ctrl+V doesn't paste into the VM in Azure Bastion

Cause Chrome on your own machine blocks the Bastion site from your clipboard

Fix Open chrome://settings/content/clipboard on your own machine, remove the Bastion site from Not allowed to see your clipboard, and reload the tab

🚨 Signing in to the VM fails

Cause The username or password isn't the VM's, for example the workshop account's, or the password was typed by hand

Fix Enter the Username from Sandbox sign-in (admin_1), paste the Password with its copy button, and try again

docs.title: 🔑 Signing in
docs.text:
🚨 You're signed in with your own account

Cause Chrome reused an account it already knew

Fix Sign out, then sign in with Continue with Microsoft and the Username from UiPath sign-in

🚨 A workshop tenant is missing from the Tenant picker

Cause You're signed in with another account, or your workshop account wasn't added to that tenant

Fix Check that you signed in with the Username from UiPath sign-in. If AgenticWorkshop or AgenticTestingWorkshop is still missing, tell the trainer

🚨 You're on another tenant

Cause The account opened its last-used tenant

Fix In the Tenant picker, in the upper-right corner, switch to the tenant the trainer names: AgenticWorkshop or AgenticTestingWorkshop

🚨 Studio Web goes blank or shows an old screen

Cause A known Studio Web display issue

Fix Open Studio Web in a fresh tab, and check the Tenant picker shows the tenant for your workshop

Still stuck?

Raise your hand. The trainer can check your VM, your workshop account, and your tenant access.

docs.title: 首页
docs.text: UiPath Partner Success · UiPath Labs

docs.title: 🧪 UiPath Labs 环境准备
docs.text:
为工作坊准备好你的 UiPath Labs 环境：虚拟机、工作坊账号和租户。按从左到右的顺序完成各个标签页，每一页最后都有一项检查。

培训环境

用你的工作坊账号登录 https://cloud.uipath.com/tpenlabs。你会在 AgenticWorkshop 和 AgenticTestingWorkshop 这两个租户中操作。

docs.title: 🎁 UiPath Labs 为你提供什么
docs.text:
工作坊的每位学员都会拿到同样一套现成的环境，所以没有人需要在课上花时间安装工具。

🖥️ 一台 Windows 虚拟机

一台在浏览器中打开的虚拟机（VM）。Chrome、UiPath Studio 以及工作坊要用到的工具都已经装好。

👤 一个工作坊账号

专为本次工作坊创建的 UiPath 账号。你用它登录，而不是用你自己的账号。

🏢 两个工作坊租户

租户 AgenticWorkshop 和 AgenticTestingWorkshop，其中的 Test Manager、Studio Web 和 Orchestrator 已为练习准备就绪。

docs.title: 🗺️ 环境准备步骤
docs.text:
1

开始之前

你会收到的两组信息，以及你自己的电脑需要准备什么

2

连接到虚拟机

用远程桌面打开虚拟机，或者通过 Azure Bastion 在浏览器中打开

3

登录

用你的工作坊账号登录 UiPath，并确认租户

4

故障排除

某个步骤不成功时该怎么办

尽早举手

如果某个步骤失败，先停下来问讲师，再继续往下做。环境准备的问题在一开始解决，比在练习做到一半时解决快得多。

docs.title: 开始之前
docs.text: 第 1 步，共 3 步

docs.title: 📋 开始之前
docs.text: 你会从 UiPath Labs 收到什么，以及你自己的电脑需要准备什么。

docs.title: 📨 你会收到的信息
docs.text: 工作坊开始前，你会收到 UiPath Labs（UiPathlabs@uipath.com）发来的两封邮件。它们可能已经在你的收件箱里了。找不到？检查一下垃圾邮件文件夹。你还可能收到第三封邮件，忽略它即可。

docs.title: ✉️ 邮件 1：Workshop Invitation
docs.text:
主题为 Workshop Invitation: 加上工作坊名称。邮件中写明了工作坊的日期和讲师。

  1. 选择 Access Workshop，或者把邮件中的链接复制到 Chrome 中。不要转发这封邮件：这个链接只属于你。
  2. 工作坊页面随即打开。页面上显示工作坊的名称、日期、时长和讲师，并用你的邮箱地址向你问好。

  3. 选择 Confirm Attendance。不要选择 Decline。

  4. 确认之后，页面会显示工作坊内容和你的 UiPath Labs 信息。

docs.title: 🖥️ 邮件 2：Sandbox created
docs.text:
主题为 Sandbox created。邮件告诉你虚拟机已经准备好，以及它的删除时间。邮件中还有一个用于 Azure Bastion 的 Click here to connect 链接，并附有一个 RDP 文件。

保留这封邮件，但不需要使用其中的链接：下一步你会通过工作坊页面进行连接。

你的虚拟机有截止时间

到了邮件中写明的日期和时间，虚拟机会连同其中的所有内容一起被删除。请在此之前完成工作坊。

docs.title: 🚫 忽略：You are invited to join uipathlabsworkshop
docs.text:
你还可能收到一封来自 UiPath Platform（no-reply@uipath.com）的邮件，主题为 You are invited to join uipathlabsworkshop。你不需要这封邮件。

不要选择 Accept Invite

忽略这封邮件。你要使用 UiPath Labs 信息中的工作坊账号登录，而不是通过这个邀请登录。

docs.title: 🗂️ 你的 UiPath Labs 信息
docs.text:
确认之后，工作坊页面会显示你的登录信息。如果它们被隐藏了，选择 Sign-in details。把这个页面保持在一个浏览器标签页中打开：接下来的步骤里你要从中复制内容。

🖥️ Sandbox sign-in（左侧）

你的虚拟机。其中有 Username 和 Password（带复制按钮），以及两种连接方式：Connect in browser 和 Remote Desktop file。

➡️ 用于连接到虚拟机

👤 UiPath sign-in（右侧）

你的工作坊账号。你通过 Continue with Microsoft 登录时使用的 Username 和 Password。

➡️ 用于登录

忽略 UiPath 地址

不要使用 UiPath sign-in 下的 Address，也不要使用 Open UiPath 按钮。工作坊使用的是 https://cloud.uipath.com/tpenlabs。在 UiPath sign-in 中，你只需要 Username 和 Password。

两个不同的账号

Sandbox 用户名用于登录虚拟机上的 Windows。UiPath 用户名用于登录 UiPath。不要把两者弄混，工作坊期间也不要使用你自己的 UiPath 账号。

docs.title: 💻 你自己的电脑需要准备什么
docs.text:
• 一个远程桌面客户端。Windows 自带 Remote Desktop Connection。在 Mac 上，从 App Store 安装 Windows App。
  • 最新版本的 Google Chrome，用于打开工作坊页面。如果你使用 Azure Bastion，虚拟机也会在 Chrome 中打开。
  • 对虚拟机的剪贴板访问权限。你要把用户名、密码和命令粘贴到虚拟机中。
  • 稳定的网络连接。关闭不需要的视频通话。

其他什么都不用安装：工作坊的所有工具都在虚拟机里运行。

保管好你的信息

你的虚拟机和工作坊账号在本次课程中归你使用。不要分享密码，也不要把密码粘贴到聊天窗口或编码智能体中。

可以进入下一步了

你已经打开了显示登录信息的工作坊页面，电脑上也有远程桌面客户端和 Chrome。下一步：连接到虚拟机。

docs.title: 连接到虚拟机
docs.text: 第 2 步，共 3 步

docs.title: 🖥️ 连接到虚拟机
docs.text: 用远程桌面打开你的虚拟机，或者通过 Azure Bastion 在浏览器标签页中打开。从这里开始，你都在虚拟机里操作。

docs.title: 🔌 选择连接方式
docs.text:
打开你的工作坊页面。Sandbox sign-in 中显示虚拟机的 Username 和 Password，并带有复制按钮。

推荐使用远程桌面。如果你无法使用远程桌面客户端，再使用 Azure Bastion。

🖥️ Remote Desktop（推荐）🌐 Azure Bastion
  1. 在 Sandbox 旁边，选择 Remote Desktop file。
  2. 打开下载的 .rdp 文件。在 Windows 上，它会在 Remote Desktop Connection 中打开；在 Mac 上，会在 Windows App 中打开。
  3. 要求输入凭据时，输入 Sandbox sign-in 中的 Username：admin_1。

  4. 选择 Sandbox sign-in 中 Password 旁边的复制按钮，粘贴密码，然后选择 Continue。

  5. 如果提示无法验证虚拟机的证书，选择 Continue。

  6. 等待虚拟机的 Windows 桌面加载完成。

Azure Bastion 会在 Chrome 标签页中打开虚拟机，所以你不需要远程桌面客户端。

  1. 在 Sandbox 旁边，选择 Connect in browser。

  2. 在 Azure Bastion 表单中，保持 Protocol 为 RDP、Port 为 3389。输入 Sandbox sign-in 中的 Username 和 Password，选择你的 Keyboard Language，然后选择 Login。

  3. 浏览器询问是否允许访问剪贴板时，选择允许。

  4. 等待虚拟机的 Windows 桌面在浏览器标签页中加载完成。

无法用 Ctrl+V 粘贴到虚拟机？

在你自己电脑上的 Chrome 中打开 chrome://settings/content/clipboard，确认 Bastion 网站不在 Not allowed to see your clipboard 列表中。然后重新加载 Bastion 标签页。

docs.title: 🧰 虚拟机桌面
docs.text:
虚拟机打开后，你会看到它的 Windows 桌面。动手练习工作坊都在这里进行。在 Sandbox created 邮件中写明的日期之前，你的工作会一直保留在虚拟机上。

你需要的工具都已经装好，桌面上有它们的快捷方式：Google Chrome、UiPath Studio、UiPath Assistant、Visual Studio Code、Git Bash 和 Excel。你不需要安装任何东西。

docs.title: 📋 检查复制和粘贴
docs.text:
在你自己的电脑上复制一些内容，然后粘贴到虚拟机中，例如粘贴到 Windows 搜索框里。如果能粘贴进去，这一步就完成了。

可以进入下一步了

虚拟机的桌面已经打开，并且可以粘贴内容。从现在起，每一步都在虚拟机中完成。下一步：登录。

docs.title: 登录
docs.text: 第 3 步，共 3 步

docs.title: 🔑 登录
docs.text: 在虚拟机中用你的工作坊账号登录 UiPath，并检查你能看到两个工作坊租户。

docs.title: 🌐 用你的工作坊账号登录
docs.text:
1. 在虚拟机中打开 Google Chrome，访问 https://cloud.uipath.com/tpenlabs。不要使用工作坊页面上的 Open UiPath：它会打开另一个地址。

  2. 选择 Continue with Microsoft。

  3. 输入 UiPath sign-in 中的 Username，然后选择 Next。

  4. 输入 UiPath sign-in 中的 Password，然后选择 Sign in。

  5. https://cloud.uipath.com/tpenlabs 的主页随即打开。检查地址栏显示的是 cloud.uipath.com/tpenlabs。

使用工作坊账号，而不是你自己的账号

如果 Chrome 用另一个账号让你登录了，请先退出登录，再通过 Continue with Microsoft 用你的工作坊账号重新登录。

docs.title: ✅ 检查你的租户
docs.text:
你的工作坊账号可以访问两个租户：AgenticWorkshop 和 AgenticTestingWorkshop。检查你能看到这两个租户。

  1. 在右上角，打开 Tenant 选择器。

  2. 检查列表中有 AgenticWorkshop 和 AgenticTestingWorkshop。想更快找到，可以在 Search 中输入名称。

  3. 如果缺少其中一个，告诉讲师。

用 Tenant 选择器切换租户

讲师会告诉你每个工作坊使用哪个租户。开始之前，在 Tenant 选择器中选择它。主页上的 Orchestrator services 也列出了同样的租户。

保持这个标签页打开

工作坊期间你还会回到这个 Chrome 标签页。如果某个页面出现空白或显示旧页面，在新标签页中打开它，并再次检查租户。

可以开始工作坊了

你已经用工作坊账号登录 https://cloud.uipath.com/tpenlabs，Tenant 选择器中显示 AgenticWorkshop 和 AgenticTestingWorkshop。你的环境已经为工作坊准备好了。

docs.title: 故障排除
docs.text: 帮助

docs.title: 🛠️ 故障排除
docs.text: 举手之前，先在这里查找你遇到的症状。如果没有列出，或者解决方法无效，请问讲师。

docs.title: 🖥️ 虚拟机
docs.text:
🚨 在 Azure Bastion 中，Ctrl+V 无法粘贴到虚拟机

原因 你自己电脑上的 Chrome 阻止了 Bastion 网站访问你的剪贴板

解决 在你自己的电脑上打开 chrome://settings/content/clipboard，把 Bastion 网站从 Not allowed to see your clipboard 中移除，然后重新加载标签页

🚨 登录虚拟机失败

原因 用户名或密码不是虚拟机的，例如用了工作坊账号的，或者密码是手动输入的

解决 输入 Sandbox sign-in 中的 Username（admin_1），用复制按钮粘贴 Password，然后重试

docs.title: 🔑 登录
docs.text:
🚨 你用自己的账号登录了

原因 Chrome 重用了它已经记住的账号

解决 退出登录，然后通过 Continue with Microsoft 用 UiPath sign-in 中的 Username 登录

🚨 Tenant 选择器中缺少某个工作坊租户

原因 你登录的是另一个账号，或者你的工作坊账号还没有被添加到该租户

解决 检查你是否用 UiPath sign-in 中的 Username 登录。如果仍然缺少 AgenticWorkshop 或 AgenticTestingWorkshop，告诉讲师

🚨 你在另一个租户上

原因 账号打开了上次使用的租户

解决 在右上角的 Tenant 选择器中，切换到讲师指定的租户：AgenticWorkshop 或 AgenticTestingWorkshop

🚨 Studio Web 出现空白或显示旧页面

原因 Studio Web 的一个已知显示问题

解决 在新标签页中打开 Studio Web，并检查 Tenant 选择器显示的是你的工作坊所用的租户

还是没解决？

请举手。讲师可以检查你的虚拟机、工作坊账号和租户访问权限。
